shelf.title: Ulysses
shelf.author: James Joyce
shelf.review:
started this as light ireland pre-reading. famous last words. maybe the point is to make you feel like odysseus reading it. confused. lost. scared.
 it got cool after I pulled up the gilbert schema though.

shelf.title: Katabasis
shelf.author: R.F. Kuang
shelf.review: my version of a colleen hoover book tbh. big fan of kuang's work on the poppy war, so this is a fun, light-hearted departure. ALSO I LOVED THE MAGIC SYSTEM. that's what math and verbal puzzles feel like to me...

shelf.title: Butter
shelf.author: Asako Yuzuki
shelf.review: this is brilliantly done, and the prose style matches the name: rich, comforting. it feels like it's going to stick to your ribs, you know? the food imagery is so vivid, and all her characters are so uniquely developed. yuzuki set the standard that made me drop 1Q84 lol.

shelf.title: Princeton Review GRE Premium Prep 2024
shelf.author: The Princeton Review
shelf.review: self-explanatory. torturous. good god. 168/162/4.5 if you're curious.

shelf.title: 1Q84
shelf.author: Haruki Murakami
shelf.review: why is he misogynist asf. dnf.

albums.title: Middle of Nowhere
albums.review: i've been singing Mexico Honey for months. no skip album. hell yeah.

albums.title: Music, Fashion, Film
albums.review: brilliant treatise on fame and ego while maintaining ultimate bop status. charli you have done it again.

albums.title: Young Manhood and Other Donatable Organs
albums.review: his lyricism is always so poignant. unfortunately, he should fire his producers, because his voice is only clearly heard on collab tracks.

albums.title: you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love
albums.review: some big winners on this album, easily. this + daisy chain fields is going to win her the grammy.

albums.title: The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore
albums.review: can i get a hear me out on this one. cleveland is slop but it's kind of sweet to have a girl who was raised on a christmas tree farm drop a christmas-style song about her new husband. and babylon is the first song she's released in years that meets taylor expectations. i have no defense for patient zero.

shows.title: Ted Lasso S1-4
shows.creator: Jason Sudeikis, Bill Lawrence, Brendan Hunt, and Joe Kelly
shows.review: comfort rewatch. no judgement please. i know i said i was into prestige tv. jay, did you mean ted lasso when you said prestige tv? NO. whatever. first 3 seasons remind you why you want to live. i wanted to like season 4 really badly, but it just kind of sucked. why is keeley pregnant.

shows.title: Deli Boys
shows.creator: Abdullah Saeed
shows.review: watched this with my little sister. we're big fans of the violence (and poorna jagannathan).

shows.title: The Bear, S1-4
shows.creator: Christopher Storer
shows.review: the first two seasons are maybe some of the greatest TV i've ever seen in my life. the second two require a lot of prestige-TV-patience. syd and carmy had something crazy going on but you didn't hear that from me.

shows.title: Severance, S1-2
shows.creator: Ben Stiller
shows.review: got the whole family bandwagoning on this one. will update when complete.

movies.title: Banshees of Inisherin
movies.review: airplane movie heading into dublin! the cinematography captures the landscape so perfectly.

movies.title: Animals
movies.review: funny as hell to drop this during the LA mayoral race. maybe the moral of the story is that we should give nithya raman a gun.

movies.title: Jailer 2
movies.review: hukum. bro that's literally superstar rajinikanth idk what you want me to say. well the movie was lowkey not good but that's not important. that's not what we're here for. my mom pulled out a murrukku bag halfway in. masala film to the max and the hrithik roshan cameo was everything to me.

movies.title: You Can See Everything
movies.review: YOOOOOOOOOOOOOO. yeah it was okay. JOKE. brilliantly woven. getting a jump on watching next year's oscar nominees, i guess!

movies.title: Wildwood
movies.review: the stop motion animation is stunning. more than worth it for that alone. and all the jokes are funny. the script is tight, but the screenplay as a whole pulls its punches whenever prue's parents show up. i don't know if the impacts of carnage are well handled, also. missed opportunity to say something meaningful about indigenous populations and limited its sense of place to a shot of portland's voodoo donuts.
